sourceRecords.title: Area 15 · Forge of Spells and its guardian
read: Scorched worktables ring a workshop that should have fallen silent centuries ago. Yet green flame still moves in a brazier at its heart. Above it, a many-eyed creature turns, and a greeting sounds inside your mind.

The brazier's green light colors the scorched tables, while the many-eyed creature hangs within the ruined workspace. Its greeting reaches you without crossing the air. There is room to answer before moving closer; the surviving forge equipment remains something to study rather than claim on sight.

sourceRecords.title: Forge use · temporary magic and item custody

brief: Forge of Spells inside small stone workshop building in cavern. Stone pedestal supports a brazier of GREEN magical flame; old forge tools, workbench, ruined furnishings. ONE spectator beholderkin if initially present: spherical levitating body, ONE large central eye and FOUR smaller eye stalks, toothy mouth. Not a full beholder. No active dwarf smiths, restored machine, Echo apparatus, dragon or huge magical loot hoard. Green fire is the room's established light, keep architecture utilitarian.
